title: Decryption-query loss in the XOR3 nAE reduction
summary: Determine whether the multiplicative decryption-query loss in the XOR3-based nAE security reduction is removable or necessary.

formal_statement.body: For the source favored ivE-plus-vector-MAC compositions whose MAC is instantiated by $\mathrm{XOR3}[f]$, let $q_d$ be the number of decryption queries in the arbitrary-query nAE game. The source obtains security from its one-decryption-query characterization with a multiplicative $q_d$ degradation. Prove a bound under the same games and primitive assumptions that avoids this multiplicative factor, or exhibit a source-admissible composition and adversary family showing that a matching dependence on $q_d$ is unavoidable.

scope.domain: The source favored ivE-plus-vector-MAC generic compositions instantiated with the XOR3 construction
assumptions: The XOR3 construction and its at-most-two-repeats condition are those of the source
The one-decryption-query and arbitrary-decryption-query nAE games are those used by the source
The underlying ivE and PRF assumptions are unchanged
scope.unresolved_remainder: No inspected later result removes the $q_d$ factor for the source XOR3-instantiated favored compositions or proves a matching lower bound showing that this exact dependence is necessary.

provenance.note: The inspected 2014 ePrint text contains the explicit unresolved quantitative question. Its cited one-query characterization supplies the baseline reduction but does not state the XOR3-specific question.

progress.summary: The source states that transferring its one-decryption-query characterization to arbitrary-query nAE security incurs a factor $q_d$ and leaves open whether this loss is artifactual or necessary.
